answer: Residency is priced by geological depth: an identity may claim a plot only after it sinks a shale anchor, a deposit whose required mass doubles each time the same funding wallet backs another claim in one dune sector, so the third stacked claim already needs four times the first. If two anchored claims are shown to share a wallet lineage, both anchors dissolve to the treasury and the wallets are barred from re-anchoring for 30 epochs. Two hundred clones thus need two hundred price-escalated deposits, roughly 1.2 million POA at the top tier, while an honest one pays the base rate once.
